params.caption: 🎮 Overwatch brings 6v6 Role Queue to Competitive Blizzard is adding a 6v6 Role Queue option to Overwatch's Competitive mode, so ranked play will no longer be 5v5 only. The developers say they've realised the two formats don't have to compete for a single winner, and both can live side by side. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:31 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #Overwatch #FPS #GamingNews
